titulo: GTA 6’s New TV Trailer Is A Bit Different, See It For Yourself
texto: GTA 6 's marketing push is ramping up substantially, and that includes with TV commercials. Eagled-eyes fans have discovered that the new GTA 6 TV spots actually contain some extended sequences, but just barely. For starters, a 30-second TV spot cuts out the steamy shower scenes with Jason and Lucia from the launch trailer . While the shower scenes are gone in this edit, the new TV spot has a slightly longer shots of an airplane sequence and another with Jason and Lucia standing next to their car. Jason playfully nudges Lucia, and in the TV spot, she nearly topples to the ground. The Xbox logo was also removed, presumably due to Rockstar's reported promotional deal with Sony. You can check out the comparison below ( via IGN ). https://twitter.com/GTAVI_Countdown/status/2112897438885245268 A 90-second version, meanwhile, includes the shower scenes, along with the slightly longer sequences
